scope: Completed C43 rebase acceptance on the pushed C42/C41/C38 stack. Seven actual-key native journeys (including bad-ID critical) and 56 static scanner resource views. A31/latest shared integration and owner Intel O1 remain separate; historical broader matrices retain their sources.

nativeJobs.scope: Accessibility and a real suspended workday are fixtures; existing IDs use their actual registered 3D adapter. All movement, aim, parcels, reply pages, photos, ID decisions, signatures and tags use real keys. No position, node, timer, ID verdict, signature-completion, score or result fixtures. A signature that has already completed is observed on its real printed-name page; transient device layout is measured only while still displayed, and the completion, full-size name choices, original score and durable reload remain required. The rebased build uses the shipped B-178 language font selection; original font diagnostics keep their old source scope.
